description: The questionnaire to ask the user: one or more questions whose answers the runtime freezes at acceptance time.

questions.description: Questions to ask, in the order the user should answer them; at least one question is required.

question.description: The question text shown to the user.

multiple.description: true allows more than one answer; omit it or send false for a single choice question.

options.description: Optional answer choices; omit when the question has no meaningful choices, because every question also accepts one free-form answer.

items.description: One answer choice of a question.

label.description: The answer label; it must be unique within its question and answers match it verbatim.

description.description: Optional elaboration of what the choice means.

recommended.description: true marks a suggestion only; at most one option per single choice question and it never replaces the user's choice.
